visual_requirements.description: Sun manifestation only: A golden living solar disk, B living solar golden-mask visage drawn from source disk/mask representations; no invented adult human body or limbs.
Active physical solar fire/radiance; A eclipse expressing source displeasure, B powerful sun illuminating temple; no neon energy or unrelated power.
A conceptual cosmic sky with sun primary; B tiny Coricancha temple below sun manifestation, temple details editorial.

A.prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mythics illustration. Imposing undeniable main subject, strong silhouette at 200 pixels, tactile painterly textures, cinematic low-key dark walnut/antique gold palette. HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, lettering, pseudo-script, logo, watermark, signature, border or frame; no borrowed film/game/anime/comic design; no nudity or explicit gore; no generic glow aura, neon outline, magical energy ribbons or floating runes; source fidelity and respect for living traditions.
ANATOMY / MANIFESTATION: INTI IS THE SUN, and source Inca art represents him as a SUN DISK. Make ONE enormous living GOLDEN SOLAR DISK occupying ninety percent of the image, an actual active sun with detailed blazing photosphere and gold natural plasma at the rim, NOT a gold coin, statue, decorative hanging plate or ordinary sun landscape. NO invented human body, adult man, arms, legs, wings or face in this pure solar-disk variant. Gold associated with god c16, actual sun c08. [inti-c08/c16] MOMENT: Dark solar eclipse passes over the upper-right quarter of the vast living sun, exposed golden surface roils and its crescent rim burns with physical solar radiance; the huge disk confronts the viewer, not scenery. POWER: Inti expresses displeasure through SOLAR ECLIPSE c06. Render a natural dark occulting lunar silhouette in front of sun and immense detailed turbulent real solar surface, physical hot gas and corona, no magical energy ribbons or glowing runes. [inti-c06/c08] SCALE & CAMERA: close conceptual cosmic portrait of the living sun deity, disk fills 90 percent square, peripheral black space only; fully readable disk outline with 5 percent margin, no little far-away sun. LIGHT & WEATHER: ONE source the sun itself, scorching antique gold on dark walnut-black, granulated orange-gold surface, corona only around actual solar rim. SURFACE: turbulent physical solar granulation/hot gas, not metallic sculpture or smooth graphic circle. SETTING: cosmic sky symbolic viewpoint, no landscape, no other unrelated objects. MOOD: overwhelming sacred cosmic authority and sublime solar power, respectful Andean divinity, not cute icon or diagram.

B.prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mythics illustration. Imposing undeniable main subject, strong silhouette at 200 pixels, tactile painterly textures, cinematic low-key dark walnut/antique gold palette. HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, lettering, pseudo-script, logo, watermark, signature, border or frame; no borrowed film/game/anime/comic design; no nudity or explicit gore; no generic glow aura, neon outline, magical energy ribbons or floating runes; source fidelity and respect for living traditions.
ANATOMY / MANIFESTATION: INTI, sun god whose documented representations include a GOLDEN MASK and SUN DISK. Manifest ONE colossal living SUN with a central GOLDEN MASK-LIKE VISAGE, ONE unified face with two eyes one nose and one mouth as restrained editorial interpretation of mask form, no detached object, no statue, no human torso, hands, limbs or adult human body. His living golden countenance seems formed in the turbulent blazing solar surface, stern downward eyes; mask interpretation c16, actual sun c08. [inti-c08/c16] MOMENT: Blaze above the viewer with solar surface churning around an imposing sacred visage, warm eyes fixed on the tiny world below, sun dominates the scene; not a stationary mask mounted on wall. POWER: immense physical sunlight and natural blazing solar plasma, reflecting gold across far-below temple stone, sourced sun divinity c05/c08. No laser eyes, beams from mouth, neon energy, floating magic runes or unrelated lightning. [inti-c05/c08] SCALE & CAMERA: low devotional view, complete enormous solar mask-disk fills top eighty-five percent square; minute Coricancha temple courtyard and tiny worshipful silhouettes sit ONLY at very bottom five percent, absolutely subordinate. Not a man before the sun. LIGHT & WEATHER: ONLY the actual sun is luminous source; scorching antique-gold surface and thick dark walnut atmospheric shadow below, natural heat shimmer. SURFACE: detailed gold countenance integrated in active photosphere, roiling orange-hot solar gas, dark weathered stone below. SETTING: Coricancha House of Sun in Cuzco c13 reduced to tiny editorial stone terrace in lower edge, no writing. MOOD: living awe-inspiring sacred sun countenance, overwhelming respected divine sovereignty, never ordinary artifact, cartoon sun or giant adult human.
